snippet.title: Wretched – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Wretched on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5058160/Wretched/

The world is dying, ravaged by an enemy known only as the Blight.
Apparently, an ancient being of immense power has decided to do something about it.

Wretched is a whimsical yet brutal turn-based tactical deckbuilder focused on positioning. Fight along a single line, read enemy intentions, and chain skills into devastating combos.
